mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that reduces equity discount rates and increases risk appetite, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days. The signal is active whenever the rate trend is downward, regardless of absolute level.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC for FEDFUNDS trend remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or average 20-day returns during declining FEDFUNDS periods are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases equity discount rates and reduces risk appetite, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or average returns during such periods are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days. The signal requires both series to be rising.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of cases, or Rank IC for the interaction term falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment falls below 4.0%, it signals a tight labor market that supports wage growth and consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 4.0, or average returns during such periods are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust manufacturing activity, which correlates with stronger corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for INDPRO trend over 60-day returns falls below 0.03 in any 2-year rolling window, or average 60-day returns during rising INDPRO periods are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.5%, it signals persistent price pressures that may trigger central bank tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.5%, or average returns during such periods are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a housing boom regime (HOUST > 1300), strong residential construction activity drives consumer confidence and spending, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of periods when HOUST > 1300, or average returns during such periods are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in employment (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment (UNRATE) indicates a tightening labor market, which supports wage growth and consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days. The signal requires both series to move in the expected direction.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising PAYEMS and falling UNRATE fails to produce positive 5-day returns in more than 40% of cases, or Rank IC for the interaction term falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
